event_data.context: Roadmap ticket 3 / Phase 1. Prove codex app-server can serve as Tiber's sole inference transport under an effective-authority contract: protocol-visible built-ins may remain, explicitly permitted read-only non-shell repository observation is untrusted context, and permissions must prevent every out-of-policy effect. The spike must preserve the shipped advisory plugin and its review orchestration. Tiber's native contract must retain risk assessment, separately assigned fresh-context review lenses, verifier routing, durable review state, delta reassessment, and clean-review gating rather than losing those behaviors during the authority cutover.
event_data.title: Prove Tiber can run an isolated Codex conversation
